title: Kubernetes Configuration & Packaging
description: Manage configuration with ConfigMaps and Secrets, expose applications with Ingress, package apps with Helm, and monitor cluster health.
longDescription: This module dives into advanced Kubernetes topics. You'll learn to manage configuration and sensitive data using ConfigMaps and Secrets, route external traffic with Ingress controllers, package multi-resource applications using Helm charts, and monitor your cluster with Prometheus, Grafana, and health probes.
whatYouLearn: Separate configuration and secrets from container images
Route external traffic to services using Ingress
Package and deploy applications with Helm charts
Monitor cluster health with metrics, logs, and health probes
